name: jellyfin

references.note: Original package list; do not run the entire list to install this package.
Installs and runs the local Jellyfin recovery check.

notes: Package methods and scripts migrated from the original repository. Availability varies by OS release and configured repositories; remote installation has not been verified during this redesign.
The watchdog expects /Applications/Jellyfin.app and the default HTTP endpoint on 127.0.0.1:8096. Install it as the Jellyfin user while logged into the Mac desktop. See packages/jellyfin/README.md.

watchdog.description: Recover the bundled Jellyfin server after it exits
watchdog.effects: Installs a per-user LaunchAgent that checks the local Jellyfin API every minute and relaunches the app if its backend is gone.
